answers.notes: Statement I is overstated: a revised identity certificate is available after surgery. Statement II matches the historical RBD 1969 correction rule. D remains the best fit; RBD 2023 amendments add some nuance.
India is the fourth docking nation after US, Russia and China. Statement 2 is therefore not correct.
Among the four names, J.C. Bose is the only figure recent commentary links to a Gandhi-like satyagraha in science. The exact epithet is not a settled textbook title.
HCES is MoSPI/NSSO, not Finance. Rural food-share remains higher than urban.

Only MuleHunter.ai and the RBI sandbox are clearly finance-sector tools. NSAI and DPDP are national frameworks, not specifically ethical AI in finance. A is the strict reading; some keys may count all four.
“Chila/chilla” is a forty-day period, not “stay indoors”. Pheran Day on 21 Dec and Chillai-Khurd/Bachha are established. Only 2 and 3 hold.
Baykar (Turkey).

Arts 16, 19 and 29 are citizen-only; Art. 28 is not.
Rarest-of-rare is settled law. Statement II overstates RG Kar as a new restriction to “no reformation” only. C remains the best reading.
NA/SA peaks are swapped. Elbrus/Elbruz (Europe) and Kosciuszko (Australia) are the usual pairs.
Risk factors are metabolic (high lipids/BP); treatment is not primarily fat-removal surgery.

Item 5 is not a standard impact of Paris withdrawal.

2017 amendments bar inheritance/transfer by heirs.
ONOE requires amending duration/session provisions including 83, 85, 172 and 174 (among others). Closest option.
DIA allows duty-free import up to (not above) ¼ carat; 10% value addition is required. Prompt asks which is not correct.
BBBP is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme under MoWCD, not a Central Sector scheme under HRD. Only statement 3 is clearly true → only one.
TB is not a typical food-borne pathogen.
GBS as autoimmune PNS disease is standard. “Primarily caused by … norovirus” overreaches. 1 only remains the safer answer.
Indian antivenom is equine, not goat-derived.

5B.2: Brindavan Hydropower v. UoI (Karnataka HC, 20 Dec 2024). 1 true (central GEOA Rules 2022). 2 false (KERC 2022 rules were green open access, not non-renewable purchase). 3 true (Centre cannot use residual s.176(2) to override Electricity Act / SERC open-access powers). 1 and 3 only → B.
IUCN Vulnerable; tropical. Kemp’s ridley is the smallest; diet is not primarily plants.
Statement 1 swaps the usual USGS 90% quake / 75% volcano figures. Valdivia 1960 is in the Ring of Fire. “15 countries” is a coaching-level rounding. Two correct remains reasonable.
Semi-Dirac: massless in one direction. Majorana (not Dirac) fermions are their own antiparticles.
WEF report, not IMF. Armed conflict was the top 2025 short-term risk.
Only Aleutian–North Pacific is right. Mariana is western Pacific; Tonga is South Pacific.
Scramjets are air-breathing. DRDO 120s ground test is documented.
Indore and Udaipur received Wetland City Accreditation.
1 and 2 describe crypto exchanges correctly. Physical-presence KYC is not mandated; V-CIP/digital KYC exists. Prompt asks which are not correct → 3 only.

PDF prints “Jalankantha”. Attested historical term is jalayantra/jala-yantra (water instrument/clock). Exact “Jalankantha” spelling is not independently established. C remains the only defensible option among the four; do not treat as confirmed. JSONL not edited.
Ramsar uses 20,000 birds not 30,000. Criteria 2, 6 and 8 match items 2–4.
Martial law is undefined; never formally declared in independent India. Art. 34 is real.
NVS-02 carries indigenous clocks and L1. It was not placed “directly” into GEO; it went to GTO and failed orbit-raising. 1 only.
Paraquat is WHO Class II (moderately hazardous), not “highly hazardous”. No reliable antidote. Still used in India and the US. Only 2 is correct.
Preamble, 19 and 21. Art. 31 repealed; Art. 15 is equality not liberty.
Native to Sumatra; bloom interval is not a rigid 20 years.
Baaz / Northern Goshawk.
Nano urea is foliar, not a soil drench. Prompt asks which is not correct.
Life expectancy is ~70, not 75. Foodgrain rank, literacy ~74–77%, Chandrayaan-3, and fifth-largest economy hold. 2–5 true → C.
Pralay is indigenous SR quasi-ballistic. It is not India’s longest SSM (Agni series). It is conventional, not nuclear. Only 1 is correct.
Whip is a party direction, not a “choice”; it is not in a parliamentary statute; it is a British convention. All three incorrect.
Origin is Sikkim (Pauhunri/Tso Lhamo), not Kailash. Teesta-III is in Sikkim.
Bharat Ratna is higher; public nominations exist; committee is not headed by the President.
India signed and ratified in 2016. NDCs are nationally determined, not identical common targets. 1 only.
PDF itself swaps Savarkar and Libia Lobo. Only Bharati’s pair is right. Flattened JSONL matches the PDF, not an extraction error.
DGFT eCoO 2.0.
All four are on India’s critical-minerals list.
2015 MMDR introduced PL-cum-ML via state auction. “All leases” is the general rule with narrow exceptions, so both can be treated as correct in UPSC style.
R1 efficiency/MoE are documented. Japan-scale 2027 electricity is a general-AI IEA-style projection, not DeepSeek-specific. 1 and 3.
Mitra Shakti is India–Sri Lanka. Indonesia is not India’s 2nd-largest trade partner. Both are in G20.
Guarantee cover is 60%, not 100%. Udyam is required. Machinery is a minimum share of project cost, not 100% of project cost. 1 and 3 are not correct.
Giddha is Punjab, not Gujarat. Other three pairs hold.
OSOWOG is an India/ISA idea and a transnational solar grid. Phase 1 is not primarily the Asia–Africa link. 3 is not correct.
HAT is parasitic, not bacterial.
e-Shram is Labour, not MSME.
Fusion weapons are thermonuclear, not “atomic” (fission) bombs.
India’s OSI uses four sub-indicators: wage growth, employment growth, hours worked, under-qualified share. Migration and automation are extras. Only four.
Indian lakes are largely eutrophic, not oligotrophic.
Definition and 1948 UNGA treaty status hold. India signed in 1949 but ratified in 1959, so “signed and ratified in 1949” fails. 1 and 2 only.
GDP ~18% to ~15% band, milk/pulses/spices leadership, and ~45% workforce are rounded but in-band. All three can stand.
Both statements are true; NDPS prohibition is why HP’s project is “controlled”. A is the intended explanation reading; B is the only real alternative.
Faulted Cretaceous coast is NCERT-standard. Official coastline length was revised upward, not reduced. 1 only.
Fentanyl is synthetic.
Squid are molluscs, not arthropods. Genetic-similarity claims and IUCN LC are the parts keys treat as true. 2 and 3.
Kenya does not border DRC. The other five do.
Rules cover waste generators, not “companies only / not households”. Local bodies and the 20 t/day or 300 t/month plan are real. Only 2 and 3 → only two.

Changed B→A. Statement 2 false: BD Act 2002 s.37 — State Government notifies BHS. Statement 3 false: Guneri inland mangrove is Gujarat’s first BHS (Gujarat govt/IE/ToI/ANI Jan 2025), not second. Only statement 1 holds → only one → A.
Tax cuts do not by themselves reduce the fiscal deficit.
CRIS developed SwaRail. Food ordering is in the super-app scope, so 2 is not correct. Prompt: not correct → 2 only.
Manipur does not border Bangladesh.
UK still leads in Ramsar count. Jharkhand/Sikkim first sites and Tamil Nadu’s lead are 2024 facts.
The two statements swap PNS vs CNS.

PDF pairs match JSONL. No “none” option. Common/CA nicknames: saffron–red diamond is the only loosely matching pair; caviar/makhana/pine nuts appear swapped vs usual “black diamond/seed diamond” usage. Question is defective. Original A retained as least-bad letter, not confirmed.
One-time-only extension and a lifetime visa-count cap are the two false claims. Green-card path and ~70% Indian share are right. Two not correct.

Liechtenstein is not a WHO member. Switzerland, Iran, DPRK are. US notified withdrawal 20 Jan 2025, effective 22 Jan 2026 — still a member in 2025. Options have no “only one”. Original A (US+Liechtenstein = only two) is the 2025 CA reading, not a strict contemporaneous-membership reading.
ELS is premium fine cotton, not coarse, and not grown in all cotton states.
Sagarmala is port-led development; the 95%/70% trade split is reversed (volume vs value).
FD excludes borrowings from receipts; FD and inflation are not inversely related.
MCA, not Commerce.
Orans–Rajasthan; Devara Kadu–Karnataka; Sarpa Kavu–Kerala only.
Also food-borne, not only direct contact.
There is no uniform national anti-conversion law. Prompt: not correct.
Budget 2025 pulse mission: tur, urad, masoor.
ICC can also act on UNSC referral of non-parties, so “only State Party” is too tight. India is not a Rome Statute party. 2 only.
Tribunals are an Assam mechanism, not JK/Arunachal.
Padma Vibhushan 2015, AKTC restorations, and AKDN work in many countries are all attested. All three.
High SO2 removal and a MoEFCC FGD mandate are true. ~20% installed is high; a blanket “five years from 31 Dec 2024” is not a clean match. Two correct is the cautious count.
Vijay Durg / Maratha naval heritage is the stated reason for Indianising the name.
8x8 Stryker is real. Chinook lift at combat weight is not. 800+ km range exceeds the usual ~500 km figure. Only 1 is clearly true.
Melt lowers albedo; it does not increase ocean reflectivity.
Parole is extra-legal vis-à-vis the 1894 Act. Definition is roughly right. Divisional Commissioner is the granting authority in several states, not a uniform national rule. Two is the usual key.
Changed D→C. Union Budget 2025-26 speech (indiabudget.gov.in para 5) lists items 1–4 verbatim, but women in economic activities is seventy per cent, not hundred per cent. Four of five match → C.
HGP launched 1990; it was public+private, not purely private.
First Indian plant was Tarapur, not Kalpakkam.
PM-KISAN is ₹6,000, not ₹10,000.

Nuclear is the second-largest low-carbon source after hydro; ~10% of 2021 generation is right. Lifecycle GHG is typically similar to or below solar, so “higher than solar and wind” is shaky. Two correct.

Stem asks which route is not part of the DFCs (not “operational only”). A = Western DFC JNPT–Dadri. B = Eastern DFC Dankuni–Sahnewal. C = proposed East Coast DFC Kharagpur–Vijayawada (DFCCIL/IE). D Bangalore–Chennai is not a named DFC (Southern DFC is typically Madgaon–Chennai). D.
RIDF is NABARD, not a Railways fund.
NAMASTE is Central Sector, not CSS. Prompt: not correct.
Potash does not harden water.
NCSK Act 1993 lapsed; the body is non-statutory. It does inquire/suo motu. It reports to the Central Government, not the President. 1 and 3 are not correct.
Repo cuts lower, not raise, EMIs.
SC 2023: re-passed bill must be assented. Reservation under 201 is not of every bill.
Late La Niña, high GHGs, aerosol decline, and a weak/short La Niña were the usual Jan 2025 explanations. All four is reasonable, not independently re-derived.
BDL–Thales MANPADS and IFEP for LPDs match Aero India 2025 notes. ASRAAM facility is Hyderabad, not Mumbai. 1 and 3.
ASHAs are incentive-based, not salaried. WHO 2022 Global Health Leaders Award is true. Age band is 25–45, not 25–40. Only one correct.
Forest/woodland deer, not desert.
GDKP is a 2025 MoSPI proposal, not NITI 2021. Knowledge-sector measurement and IPP-in-GFCF are right. 2 and 3.
US rate hikes and trade wars can depreciate INR. Falling imports support the rupee. Two factors.
MHW definition is percentile-based; they are not summer-only; most are not “natural”.
